slides.eyebrow: This will change how you see closing:
slides.sub: Your last look before the sale is final. Ask for it about 24 hours before closing.
slides.source: HUD, Closing the Deal; Freddie Mac

slides.title: 1. Agreed repairs
slides.body: Make sure [[everything the seller agreed to fix]] was fixed. Your agent can walk through it with you and check each one.

slides.title: 2. What stays, what goes
slides.body: Anything the seller agreed to leave [[is still there]]. Anything they agreed to take is gone, and the seller has fully moved out.

slides.title: 3. The house itself
slides.body: Check the walls, ceilings, [[mechanical systems]], plumbing, windows and roof. An empty house can show things the furniture hid.

slides.title: 4. Anything new
slides.body: Look for [[new damage]]. If something's wrong, tell your agent and the seller before you sign. The seller may fix it or offer a credit. Talk to a real estate attorney about your situation.

caption:
